name: B10-0402/2026 (ESN) – Political prisoners in Cuba, in particular the case of Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on political prisoners in Cuba, in particular the case of Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of Félix Navarro and his daughter Sayli Navarro, and of all other political prisoners in Cuba. It condemns the Cuban government's repression and says the prisoner release announced in April 2026 was only propaganda. It asks the European Union to suspend its cooperation agreement with Cuba and to freeze all European Union money sent to Cuba. The Parliament is stating its position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks the European Union to suspend its agreement with Cuba and freeze its funding.
- This affects the Cuban government and people imprisoned for the July 2021 protests.
- The request now goes to the European Commission, the Council and member states.
